qualification.details: General Manager - IBU (IFSC Banking Unit) Qualifications: Graduation or Post Graduation in any discipline or Chartered Accountant (CA). Experience: 15 Years of experience in Officer Cadre of Public / Private / Foreign Banks with minimum 3 years of experience in any Offshore Banking Unit / Overseas Branch of the Bank / IFSC Banking unit of Public / Private Banks. Current Assignment must be: (a) Deputy General Manager (equivalent role in private / foreign banks i.e., current designation 4 level below MD & CEO) with minimum 1 year in present cadre OR (b) Assistant General Manager (equivalent role in private / foreign banks i.e., current designation 5 level below MD & CEO) with minimum 2 years in present cadre. Desirable Experience: Exposure of Forex business or Global Trade Business on International Banking in Indian / Foreign Banks.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IOB General Manager – IBU recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IOB General Manager – IBU (IFSC Banking Unit) post is 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the General Manager post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of General Manager – IBU (IFSC Banking Unit) in the Indian Overseas Bank recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation or Post Graduation degree in any discipline or be a Chartered Accountant (CA). Preferred qualifications include MBA/PGDM/PGDBF with specialization in Finance/Banking/International Business or CFA/FRM/PRM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the General Manager position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the General Manager – IBU (IFSC Banking Unit) post is 55 years as of the notification date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the General Manager post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a pay scale of Rs.156500-4340/4-173860, with an approximate CTC of Rs. 44 lacs per annum, along with other allowances.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IOB General Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply online through the official website of Indian Overseas Bank. The application link and detailed instructions are provided in the 'How to Apply' and 'Important Links' sections.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the IOB General Manager post?
faq.answer: The application fee is INR 175/- for SC/ST/PwBD candidates and INR 1000/- for GEN/EWS/OBC candidates, inclusive of GST.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preliminary screening of applications followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the required experience for the General Manager – IBU post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 15 years of experience in Officer Cadre of Public/Private/Foreign Banks is required, with at least 3 years in an Offshore Banking Unit/Overseas Branch/IFSC Banking unit.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the IOB IFSC Banking Unit located?
faq.answer: The IOB IFSC Banking Unit is located in GIFT CITY, Gujarat.
